metadata.question: In the Norwegian Sea during Septermber 19, 2019, is the water color at (46.694935, -50.925784) more milky than (46.809436, -58.528990)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (best for water color/turbidity analysis) - Date: September 19, 2019 (exact date or narrow window around it) - Locations: Two points in the Norwegian Sea * Point 1: (46.694935, -50.925784) * Point 2: (46.809436, -58.528990) - Indicator for "milky" water: High turbidity/suspended sediment → use True Color or NIR-based indices (e.g., high Blue/Green ratio, or Suspended Sediment Index) 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds (QA60 band) to get clear water observations - Note: The question asks about water color on a specific date, so we need valid, cloud-free pixels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero (A/B): Both points have valid turbidity measurements; compare which is "more milky" (higher turbidity) - C1: No Sentinel-2 images on/near Sept 19, 2019 for the region - C2: Images exist but clouds mask all pixels at both locations - C3: Calculation returns NaN or invalid values (e.g., negative reflectance) - D: Collection/band errors For "milky" water, I'll use a simple turbidity proxy: the Blue/Green reflectance ratio or Suspended Sediment Index (SSI). A higher ratio indicates more suspended sediment → more "milky" appearance. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define two locations const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-50.925784, 46.694935]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.528990, 46.809436]); // Date range around September 19, 2019 const startDate = '2019-09-15'; const endDate = '2019-09-23'; // Sentinel-2 collection with cloud masking let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point1.buffer(50000).union(point2.buffer(50000))) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const imgCount = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 images found in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get median composite to reduce noise let img = col.median(); // Cloud and shadow masking function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; return img.updateMask(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))); } img = maskClouds(img); // Calculate turbidity proxy: SSI (Suspended Sediment Index) // SSI = (Red + NIR) / Green (higher = more sediment/milky) const red = img.select('B4'); const green = img.select('B3'); const nir = img.select('B8'); const ssi = (red.add(nir)).divide(green).rename('SSI'); // Measure at point 1 const stats1 = ssi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point1, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const val1 = await stats1.get('SSI').getInfo(); // Measure at point 2 const stats2 = ssi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point2, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const val2 = await stats2.get('SSI').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const count1 = await img.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point1, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); const count2 = await img.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point2, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); console.log(`Point 1: SSI=${val1 !== null ? val1.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Point 2: SSI=${val2 !== null ? val2.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, pixels=${count2}`); // Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking at one or both locations.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('Invalid calculation result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: Point 1 more milky than Point 2? if (val1 > val2) { console.log(`Point 1 (SSI=${val1.toFixed(3)}) > Point 2 (SSI=${val2.toFixed(3)}): More milky.`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Point 1 (SSI=${val1.toFixed(3)}) ≤ Point 2 (SSI=${val2.toFixed(3)}): Less or equally milky.`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
